title: Grand Sri Lanka in Ten Days: Dambulla, Kandy, Yala and Bentota
alt: A leopard resting on a rock in Yala National Park
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide; 4x4 jeep for the Yala safari

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Half day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the Fort district and Independence Square in an afternoon.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A first night on the Mount Lavinia beachfront with a half day of the capital to start.

stops.name: Dambulla
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel among the paddy fields outside Dambulla

activities.name: Dambulla sightseeing tour
activities.description: The five cave shrines of the golden temple, the Buddhist museum and the old village tank.

program.name: Dambulla
program.description: Two nights in the Cultural Triangle with a free afternoon on arrival and a day of the cave temple, the museum and the village.

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

activities.name: Full day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Peradeniya gardens, the Bahiravokanda Buddha and the gem museum.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights in the hill capital with the elephants on the way, the dance show and a full day of the city.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.hotel: Oak-Ray Summer Hill Breeze Hotel, Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Lover's Leap waterfall
activities.description: A short walk through the Pedro tea estate to the thirty metre fall above Nuwara Eliya.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country with a stop at the Lovers Leap waterfall above the town.

stops.name: Yala
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class lodge on the edge of Yala National Park

activities.name: Optional: Yala jeep safari
activities.description: A dawn or dusk 4x4 safari through block one, home to leopards, elephants, sloth bears and crocodiles.

program.name: Yala
program.description: Across the hills to the dry south east for a night on the edge of the park.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class beach hotel with a pool facing the sea

activities.name: Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: The hatchery south of Bentota where eggs are protected and hatchlings released into the sea at dusk.

activities.name: Full day Bentota sightseeing
activities.description: The Madu Ganga boat ride, the Kosgoda turtle hatchery, the Galapatha temple and an afternoon on Bentota beach.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with the turtle hatchery on arrival and a full day of the Madu River, the cinnamon island and the sand.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Yala at dawn is the single best morning you can have in Sri Lanka. Leopards are shy, but the elephants and peacocks never disappoint.
expert.tip: Wear neutral colours for the safari and keep the camera ready at the waterholes. The first hour after the gates open is when the cats move.

summary: The full island in ten days: Colombo, two nights in the Cultural Triangle at Dambulla, two in Kandy with the elephants and the dance show, the tea country and Lovers Leap, a night on the edge of Yala, and two nights on the beach at Bentota with the turtles and the Madu River.
included: Included: 9 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily (lunch or dinner also in Dambulla and Nuwara Eliya); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a half day Colombo sightseeing tour; the Dambulla sightseeing tour; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; a full day Kandy sightseeing tour; Lovers Leap waterfall; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a full day Bentota sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; the Yala jeep safari and park ticket; lunches and dinners unless stated; entrance tickets where payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
